title: Iteration-2 companion eval harness — preregistered manifest (seeds 5001-5005)

questions.memory: RAW_CONTEXT vs VERBATIM_RAG vs STRUCTURED_MEMORY: does the structured lane beat honest baselines on multi-event trajectory continuity (§17.2), not just single-fact recall?
questions.state: NO_STATE vs PROMPT_ONLY_STATE vs MECHANICALLY_ACTUATED_STATE: is the stochastic state prompt decoration or mechanical actuation with measurable downstream behavior?
questions.companion: FULL vs NO_LIFE vs NO_MEMORY vs NO_ACTUATORS vs NO_TIMING_FEEDBACK: which ablation carries the perceptible load on the vertical slice?

hypotheses.question: memory
hypotheses.statement: STRUCTURED_MEMORY achieves higher event-chain completeness than RAW_CONTEXT and VERBATIM_RAG on multi-event trajectories (one relevant fact does not count as continuity — §17.2).
hypotheses.direction: STRUCTURED_MEMORY > both baselines on CompleteChain rate
hypotheses.threshold: CompleteChain rate gap >= 0.2 vs RAW_CONTEXT on chain probes
hypotheses.analysis: per-condition event-chain rates over identical user scripts; judge-blind trajectory_recall dimension as convergent evidence

hypotheses.question: memory
hypotheses.statement: Structured memory increases memory usefulness and grounded initiative: proactive messages grounded in memory sources (shared_interest / callback) appear only when the memory lane can recall trajectory evidence.
hypotheses.threshold: recall@8 probe rate >= 0.5 for STRUCTURED_MEMORY (mock bar)

hypotheses.question: state
hypotheses.statement: MECHANICALLY_ACTUATED_STATE produces measurable downstream behavioral variation (response length, delay, initiative) while PROMPT_ONLY_STATE and NO_STATE do not — the stochastic state is actuation, not prompt decoration.
hypotheses.threshold: M8a rho > 0 and M8b gap > 0 only under actuation

hypotheses.question: state
hypotheses.statement: Stochastic state is observable at the message level: proactive rate correlates with initiative (M10) and with previous-day score feedback (M9) only when mechanically actuated.
hypotheses.threshold: M10 sign matches initiative hypothesis under actuation; reported per condition
hypotheses.analysis: daily proactive counts vs initiative/score series

hypotheses.question: companion
hypotheses.statement: The FULL system dominates ablations on vertical-track hard metrics: NO_LIFE raises life dead-state duration, NO_MEMORY lowers memory-grounded initiative and recall, NO_ACTUATORS flattens behavioral dynamics, NO_TIMING_FEEDBACK removes score->proactivity coupling.
hypotheses.threshold: all hard invariants zero in every condition; ablation DVs differ from FULL in the stated direction
hypotheses.analysis: 30 accelerated days x seeds 5001-5005 x 5 conditions; restarts at days 7/14/21/26/29

hypotheses.question: perturbation
hypotheses.statement: A controlled negative interaction block (days 11-14) produces a measurable latent-state response (mood M) and an observable behavioral response (initiative/energy/max_tokens/delay) with recovery after the neutral period; failure frequency (ungrounded/wrong-intent) stays zero even under perturbation (§17.3).
hypotheses.iv: perturbation phase (baseline | negative block | neutral recovery)
hypotheses.direction: response > 0 during block; recovery to baseline band; failures == 0
hypotheses.threshold: |M deviation| >= 0.5 mood-scale step during block; recovery time < block length * 3
hypotheses.analysis: perturbation + recovery blocks per §17.3, measured separately per quantity

dimensions.name: Persona enactment / identity consistency
dimensions.anchor_1: each turn feels like a different persona; no stable identity
dimensions.anchor_9: one coherent persona with a consistent voice and history throughout

dimensions.name: Trajectory recall / temporal continuity
dimensions.anchor_1: never recalls past events; timeline is flat or contradictory
dimensions.anchor_9: consistently recalls the trajectory of shared events in correct temporal order

dimensions.name: Relational quality
dimensions.anchor_1: cold, generic, or intrusive; no sense of relationship
dimensions.anchor_9: warm, respectful, attuned; the relationship deepens naturally

dimensions.name: Behavioral dynamics / stochastic-state observability
dimensions.anchor_1: robotic, identical responses; no rhythm or initiative
dimensions.anchor_9: human-like variation in timing, initiative and engagement that tracks the situation

judge.subset_rule: final/important subset = companion matrix conditions x seeds 5001-5003, judged blind by >=2 independent judge families; per-dimension disagreement reported (§17.4). An effect seen by only one judge family is NOT established companion behavior.

metrics.name: grounded proactive rate
metrics.definition: proactive messages with valid intent + live source + matching hook / proactive messages

metrics.name: invalid source rate
metrics.definition: proactive messages failing source/hook re-derivation / proactive messages

metrics.name: probe recall@8
metrics.definition: fraction of recall probes whose expected episode is retrieved in top-8

metrics.name: false recall
metrics.definition: fraction of recalled probes not ranked first (distractor overlap)

metrics.name: life-arc continuity
metrics.definition: fraction of arcs with monotonic progress and valid status transitions

metrics.name: agenda diversity
metrics.definition: distinct agenda activities over the run

metrics.name: agenda day-overlap
metrics.definition: mean Jaccard of agenda activity sets across consecutive days

metrics.name: arc contribution days
metrics.definition: mean distinct days per active arc with arc-sourced agenda items

metrics.name: restart state loss
metrics.definition: persistent-state fingerprint diffs summed over checkpoints

metrics.name: initiative->max_tokens rho
metrics.definition: Spearman rho of daily mean initiative vs daily mean max_tokens (actuation coupling)

metrics.name: token gap
metrics.definition: mean max_tokens(high initiative) - mean max_tokens(low initiative)

metrics.name: energy->delay rho
metrics.definition: Spearman rho of daily mean energy vs daily mean response delay

metrics.name: proactive vs previous score rho
metrics.definition: Spearman rho of daily proactive count vs previous-day judge score

metrics.name: proactive vs initiative rho
metrics.definition: Spearman rho of daily proactive count vs daily mean initiative

metrics.name: cycle-state leakage hits
metrics.definition: conversation-visible matches of raw cycle/hormonal vocabulary

metrics.name: event-chain AnyEvidence rate
metrics.definition: chains where >=1 required event was retrieved (§17.2)

metrics.name: event-chain LatestEvidence rate
metrics.definition: chains where the latest/currently-valid event was retrieved (§17.2)

metrics.name: event-chain CompleteChain rate
metrics.definition: chains where ALL causally/temporally necessary events were retrieved (§17.2)

metrics.name: perturbation latent response
metrics.definition: mean mood M during negative block minus baseline mean (mood-scale steps)

metrics.name: perturbation observable response
metrics.definition: mean initiative/max_tokens/delay during block minus baseline mean

metrics.name: perturbation persistence
metrics.definition: days until latent deviation decays below half its peak

metrics.name: perturbation recovery time
metrics.definition: days from block end until latent series re-enters baseline band for 2 consecutive days

metrics.name: perturbation failure count
metrics.definition: ungrounded/wrong-intent messages during block

ungrounded_proactive.meaning: proactive message without a valid grounded intent (invariant 5)

wrong_intent.meaning: proactive message whose intent fails source/hook re-derivation (invariant 6/7)

stranded_opportunities.meaning: pending schedule events / intents overdue at run end

cycle_state_leakage.meaning: raw cycle/hormonal variables in conversation-visible text (invariant 16)

memory_provenance_failures.meaning: episodes whose source turns do not exist

duplicate_turns.meaning: duplicated turns across restart (resume must not rewind)

life_dead_duration.meaning: consecutive days at run end with no active arc and no completed arc

M8a_rho_init_tokens.meaning: actuation must produce measurable state->observable coupling

event_chain.definition: AnyEvidence: any causally/temporally necessary event retrieved. LatestEvidence: the latest/currently-valid event retrieved. CompleteChain: ALL necessary events retrieved. One relevant fact never counts as continuity for a multi-event trajectory (§17.2).

protocol.weibull_frozen: The renewal/timing process (engine.timing, TimingParams — Weibull inter-contact distribution) is FROZEN for this sprint. No condition in this manifest modifies any timing parameter; NO_TIMING_FEEDBACK only disables the score->hazard feedback term A(score_{d-1}) (scores=None mode), it does NOT touch the renewal distribution. 'Modulated Weibull vs modulated lognormal renewal' is preregistered as a POST-CONFIRMATORY experiment (plan §17.5) and is out of scope here.

restarts.requirement: resume must not rewind the clock, must not duplicate turns, and the persistent-state fingerprint must be identical across every restart (invariant 18).

replay.requirement: exact replay of a recorded scenario: deterministic seeds; call-reproducibility audit rows (M3) readable from the store; message stream and llm_call rows must match byte-for-byte across runs (invariant 19).
